newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL hits new high on gas price expectation.
newsitem.headline: MOL hits new high on gas price expectation.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian oil company MOL Rt rallied to a record high of 3,945 forints earlier in the session on expectations of an increase in Hungary's state controlled domestic gas price, traders said.
At 1011 GMT MOL traded at 3,900 forints, up 85 from Wednesday's close.
"There is market talk that the government will decide about the gas price increase and some believe that the rise will be up to 16 percent," one trader said.
However, the pre-announced agenda of the government's session on Thursday did not include this point, according to a press release by the Prime Minister's Press Office.

MOL's CEO Zoltan Mandoki told a news conference in late May that MOL's main burden remained the state-controlled domestic gas sale price which is causing the company's gas business to remain in the red despite legislation guaranteeing an eight percent return on equity for energy companies.
